mixed_1.title: Which Republican U.S. Senate candidate will be reported by August 25, 2026, to have asked AIPAC not to campaign on their behalf?
mixed_1.background: The American Israel Public Affairs Committee (AIPAC) is a pro-Israel lobbying organization active in congressional elections. Its political support has historically extended to candidates from both major U.S. parties. The next midterm elections are scheduled for November 2026.
mixed_1.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Reporting by established news organizations published by August 25, 2026.
  • Resolution Conditions: Identify the Republican candidate for U.S. Senate in the November 2026 election reported to have requested that AIPAC not run a campaign on their behalf. A request conveyed through the candidate's campaign allies qualifies; merely criticizing AIPAC does not.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The candidate's first and last name.
